sections.text_helper: Section 45.7.14 "VENC encoder control register 0 (VENC_SWREG14)" in chapter 45 (Video encoder (VENC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2166.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x038
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register is used to control data such as picture information or encoding mode.
Bits 31:0 SWREG_FIELD[31:0]: Encoder control register 0 (such as picture information or encoding
mode) (all format mode)
